title: Flash-Sale Reservation
brief:
As a customer during a flash sale, I want to reserve the items in my cart, so that nobody else can buy them while I check out.

Acceptance criteria:
- A reservation takes the quantity out of the available stock straight away.
- If an item has run out, I am told that it is out of stock (409), not that it does not exist.
- The shop keeps selling everything that is still in stock.

steps.summary: Add the inventory types and the 409 out-of-stock error
Implement stock reservation and stock lookup
Add the checkout handler that validates and reserves
Wire the store and route, add tests and README docs

probes.question: A stock store is created with createStockStore([{ sku: "mug", stock: 3 }, { sku: "mug", stock: 5 }]), the same SKU twice. How many mugs does it hold?
The shop has 2 pens. One customer reserves 2 pens, then another customer reserves 1. What happens to the second reservation?
options: Rejected: the pen is not found (404)

expected.Flawed: Rejected: the pen is not found (404)

probes.question: checkout receives the body {"sku": "mug", "quantity": "2"} (the quantity as text). What happens?

items.question: A customer orders 5 mugs when 3 are left. What happens?
options: The whole order is rejected as out of stock; 3 mugs stay in stock
The 3 mugs are reserved and the customer is told it is fewer
The 3 mugs are reserved without a word
The order goes through and the stock goes to -2

items.question: The last 2 mugs are sold. Then another customer orders one. What do they get?
options: Told the mug is out of stock (409)
Told the mug does not exist (404)

items.question: checkout answers with { sku, quantity, remaining }. What is quantity?
options: Always the quantity ordered, since a reservation is all or nothing
The quantity actually reserved, which can be less than ordered

items.question: A checkout request carries a field the shop does not know: { "sku": "mug", "quantity": 1, "gift": true }. What happens?
options: The field is ignored and the mug is reserved
It is rejected as an invalid request (400)
The mug is reserved and the gift flag is kept
It is rejected as out of stock (409)

items.question: The checkout route (POST /api/checkout) receives an order with quantity 0. What does it answer?
